entities.summary: Ferdinando Ruggeri was an Italian architect and engraver, active in Florence during the late Baroque period. Ruggieri helped design the left facade of the Church of San Firenze (1715), the Palazzo Capponi in Florence, the Palazzo Sansedoni (1736) in Siena, and the collegiata (1738) of Empoli. He also published books of architecture.
